item.title: Loraine James Details New Album, ‘Detached From The Rest Of You’
item.description: It features Alan Sparkhawk, Tirzah and more Loraine James has shared details of her fourth studio album, Detached From The Rest Of You. Due for release via her long-time label home of Hyperdub, the 12-track record features contributions from Alan Sparhawk, Tirzah, Anysia Kim, Miho Hatori, Le3 bLACK and Fyn Dobson. item.title: The Auteurs Sing Uber Hate: After Murder Park At 30
item.description: Self-hobbled and confined to a wheelchair, Luke Haines dug deep into middle England’s psychic hinterland to produce the definitive anti-Britpop album. Joe Banks reflects on a “monsterpiece” that still resonates today This article was originally published in 2021 As an opening track, ‘Light Aircraft On Fire’ is a vicious, lip-curled statement of intent. item.title: Green Man Unveils Lineup for 2026 Edition
item.description: Wilco, Mogwai, Four Tet and Wolf Alice will headline this year's festival Photo by Patrick Gunning Green Man has shared the full lineup for its 2026 edition. This year's festival, taking place at its usual Bannau Brycheiniog National Park home, will be headlined by Wilco, Mogwai, Four Tet and Wolf Alice. item.title: Seefeel Reveal First New Album in 15 Years
item.description: Sol.Hz is described as the group's 'dub' album Photo by Jeff Pitcher Seefeel are set to release their first new album in 15 years, titled Sol.Hz. Comprised of nine tracks, the LP is described in a press release as the group's 'dub' album, and follows on from 2024's mini-album Squared Roots. As with past Seefeel material, it centres around the deep, IDM-indebted production of Mark Clifford and vocals of Sarah Peacock. Watch a video for the album's lead track, 'Ever No Way', below. item.title: Ragger – Euphonic Sounds
item.description: Ragger Euphonic Sounds Los Angeles duo play ragtime with Gameboy sounds, at once comic and oddly disquieting Euphonic Sounds by Ragger Ragger’s Euphonic Sounds is a temporal anomaly tripping over itself and tumbling out your speakers.
